name: Aisyah Rahman
bio:
Aisyah Rahman’s journey into motorsport engineering began with a childhood fascination for deconstructing and rebuilding electronics. This passion led her to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in automotive systems. After graduating at the top of her class, she started her career at Proton, Malaysia's national car manufacturer, quickly rising through the ranks due to her sharp analytical skills and pragmatic approach to problem-solving. Her work on improving engine performance and fuel efficiency caught the attention of a European racing team, and she was headhunted to join their ranks, specializing in data analysis and simulations. 

With Porsche Penske Motorsport, Aisyah leverages her extensive experience in both manufacturing and high-performance racing. Her approach emphasizes a holistic understanding of the car as a system, constantly seeking marginal gains through meticulous data analysis and innovative solutions. Calm and collected under pressure, Aisyah believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every member of the engineering team feels empowered to contribute their expertise, which ultimately delivers a competitive edge on the track. Her reputation as a calm, confident leader precedes her.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Aisyah has a warm, friendly face framed by high cheekbones and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deeply concentrating.
Insists on a specific brand of Malaysian tea being available in the garage at all times.
